subject: Data stewardship scrub & temporary processor justification request
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@greenline-payments.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Processor roster + residency mapping request (Greenline)

Connor —

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. As part of our procurement security review I need a short inventory of all third parties Redwood uses that process Greenline customer data (including analytics, observability, caching, KMS, telemetry relays). For each vendor please provide the following columns: vendor name, primary function, jurisdictions where customer data may be processed, encryption/KMS ownership, whether they have access to plaintext, legal basis (subprocessor under DPA / contractual necessity), and whether there is an onshore fallback.

We also need any temporary processors (<=90 days) that might be used during migrations or bursts, plus a justification for each and an expected removal date.

If you can get an initial packet by EOD Nov 9th that would keep us on track for security signoff next week. If something is sensitive you can mark it confidential and we can arrange an SSO+Link to a locked Drive folder.

Appreciate it —
Elaine Park
Senior Risk Manager | Greenline Payments
elaine.park@greenline-payments.com
Attachment: greenline_request_template.csv (stub: columns requested)

Subject: Re: Processor roster + residency mapping request (Greenline)

Elaine —

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes / plan:
- I'll coordinate the inventory pull and populate the columns you listed.
- Marissa will validate contractual coverage / DPA clauses.
- Ben will confirm whether any temporary processors are in use for burst/maintenance windows and provide justification.
- I'm looping in Kimberly from Security to prepare the accompanying evidence (KMS diagrams, export controls, attestation statements).

We should be able to deliver a redacted packet with the requested columns + a full evidence bundle (for your security reviewers) by Nov 9 EOD. If Greenline needs the full unredacted file earlier, let me know and we can arrange SSO Drive access.

Connor / Kimberly / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for sending the draft addendum. A couple of quick clarifications before we route to our legal and infra reviewers:

1) For temporary processors please include the exact expected removal date and whether any customer PII is retained beyond the temp window; retention beyond 7 days requires an exception.
2) For each vendor row please add a short description of the legal basis under the DPA (e.g., 'subprocessor under section 2.1', or 'data processor for telemetry only — contractual necessity') so our legal team can triage faster.
3) We need explicit KMS ownership: does Redwodn (sic) control the KMS keys for the telemetry/cache vendor, or does the vendor manage keys? (If vendor-managed, include HSM/KMS provider name and whether keys are exportable.)
4) Upload the evidence bundle to the Drive folder in your related_links and then drop the DocuSign link for the DPA addendum when ready.

If you can address 1–3 in the redacted packet and put the full evidence in the locked Drive by EOD Nov 10 that would be ideal. If any item will take longer (SCCs / export paperwork), please call that out in the packet.

Best —
Elaine Park
Senior Risk Manager | Greenline Payments
Attachments referenced: none; prefer Drive link.

On a separate note: please ensure the telemetry vendor entry contains whether they use continuous batching / KV-cache that might cause cross-region replication — that affects residency assessments.
